credits.label: Annual Chase Travel hotel credit
usageTerms: Eligible hotel accommodation booked through Chase Travel; account-anniversary-year benefit.
credits._note: Current issuer page provides up to $100 in statement credits each account-anniversary year for qualifying hotel accommodations purchased through Chase Travel.

credits.label: DoorDash non-restaurant monthly promo
usageTerms: Requires activated eligible DashPass benefit; applies to qualifying non-restaurant DoorDash orders under issuer terms.
credits._note: Eligible DashPass members receive a $10 monthly promo for groceries, retail orders and other qualifying non-restaurant DoorDash purchases through 2027-12-31.

credits.label: Annual Travel Credit
usageTerms: Automatic statement credits for purchases coded as eligible travel; credited portion does not earn travel points under issuer terms.
credits._note: Automatic statement credits up to $300 each account-anniversary year for eligible travel purchases charged by the primary or authorized users; credited travel does not earn travel rewards on that amount.

credits.label: Select Chase Travel hotels credit (2026)
usageTerms: Prepaid Pay Now stay, at least two nights, at an eligible listed brand.
credits._note: Automatic statement credits up to $250 during calendar 2026 for prepaid Pay Now stays of two nights or more at issuer-listed select hotel brands through Chase Travel.

credits.label: Sapphire Reserve Exclusive Tables dining credit

enrollment.instructions: Link eligible Reserve card to OpenTable profile

usageTerms: Eligible direct restaurant purchase at a participating restaurant; issuer terms govern processor/third-party exclusions.
credits._note: Up to $150 January-June and another $150 July-December at restaurants in the Sapphire Reserve Exclusive Tables program on OpenTable.

credits.label: StubHub and viagogo credit

enrollment.instructions: Activate in Chase.com or Chase Mobile

usageTerms: Direct purchases only; gift cards excluded; UK redirected purchases excluded.
credits._note: After activation, up to $150 January-June and $150 July-December for direct StubHub and viagogo purchases through 2027-12-31; no minimum purchase. Purchases for UK events redirected to stubhub.co.uk do not qualify.

credits.label: Lyft monthly in-app credit

enrollment.instructions: Add eligible card to Lyft app

usageTerms: Qualifying Standard, Extra Comfort, XL, Black, or Black SUV rides; membership purchases and certain fees/tips/gift cards excluded.
credits._note: The first primary/employee/authorized user who adds an eligible Reserve card to Lyft gets a $10 in-app credit each calendar month for qualifying rides through 2027-09-30.

credits.label: Peloton membership credit

enrollment.instructions: Activate on Chase.com/Chase Mobile and Peloton

usageTerms: Eligible Peloton membership; sign up/sign in through Peloton with eligible card on file; Apple/Google app-store purchases excluded.
credits._note: After one-time activation, up to $10 per month for eligible Peloton memberships through 2027-12-31. Third-party app-store purchases do not qualify.

credits.label: DoorDash restaurant monthly promo
usageTerms: Requires activated eligible DashPass benefit and use within DoorDash.
credits._note: DashPass members receive a $5 monthly promo for restaurant orders through 2027-12-31.
